questions.q: In the Driftwood Trail Outfitters scenario, what replaces the three separate per-workspace Hive metastores?
options: Three separate Unity Catalog metastores, one per region
A single Unity Catalog metastore with all three workspaces attached
A shared spreadsheet listing all tables
Nothing — the Hive metastores stay as they were
questions.explain: Chapter 1's fix is one Unity Catalog metastore replacing three independent Hive metastores, giving the whole organization one governed boundary instead of three.

questions.q: How does the governance team handle the sales table's customer email column without withholding the whole table from most of the company?
options: They delete the email column entirely
They apply a column mask so only the Finance group sees full emails
They create three separate copies of the table, one per permission level
They require every employee to request access individually, every time
questions.explain: A column mask lets the same underlying table serve different audiences — Finance sees the real email addresses, everyone else sees a masked version, with no duplicate tables to keep in sync.

questions.q: What replaces the manual, emailed CSV sent to the logistics partner each month?
options: A faster, automated email with the same CSV attachment
A real Delta Share, with a scoped recipient and a revocable grant
Giving the partner a login to the full production workspace
Nothing — the case study leaves this problem unsolved
questions.explain: Chapter 5's Delta Sharing material gets applied directly: a CREATE SHARE with a masked table added, and a recipient scoped to the partner's metastore — auditable and revocable, unlike an email attachment.

questions.q: How does the case study fix the forecasting model's missing lineage?
options: By manually writing a document listing which table trained the model
By having retraining code log its input dataset, so lineage shows the real source table
By deleting the model and starting over
Lineage can't be fixed after the fact, so the model is retired
questions.explain: Once retraining code logs its input dataset with mlflow.log_input(), Unity Catalog can draw a real lineage link from the model version to the table that trained it — exactly the Lesson 22 mechanism.

questions.q: What is explicitly true about Driftwood Trail Outfitters, per this lesson?
options: It is a real company whose data is used with permission
It is a fictional, illustrative company invented for this case study
It is a real company but anonymized
It is a Databricks customer referenced in official documentation
questions.explain: The lesson explicitly labels Driftwood Trail Outfitters as fictional and illustrative — a realistic composite scenario, not a real company or real data.
